SMS Policy & Procedure (13 April 2026)

Purpose: SMS "text and response" now sits inside our CRM (Splose) to improve data integrity, response speed and audit compliance. It follows the company's Privacy & Confidentiality and Data/Information Security policy, so all participant data must be collected and kept only in organisation systems.

Key rules:
- Send all SMS from within Splose. Use the client's profile, on desktop or in the Splose webpage on your phone.
- Log in at www.aspire-and-grow-services.splose.com with your own credentials.
- Sending an SMS to a client is billable. Bill it under Care Coordination. You can do this at the end of the day or the next time you complete progress notes or therapy for that participant.
- No automatic appointment reminders are being introduced.
- $10 a week charge is managed through the existing weekly invoicing process (Xero).
- Sending SMS this way keeps emails and SMS within the company environment, encrypted.

Coming up: The next version of the policy is expected to include SMS via Optus Loop / RingCentral.
